youtube_description:
How To Use @ on Chromebook | Chromebook Keyboard Shortcuts | Chromebook Keyboard Tips and Tricks

Finding @ button on Chromebook may sound simple and easy, but it can be confusing. I had problems using @ on my Chromebook in the past.

At @ button on your Chromebook won't work with Ctrl or Alt keys. Press @ and Shift on your Chromebook type @ symbol. 

In this video, I will show you how to use @ on your Chromebook and if it works.
